## Change

Describe the generic software change and its expected effect. Use only neutral
labels and independently invented minimal examples.

## Verification

Describe checks performed using synthetic inputs only. Do not paste raw logs,
screenshots, local commands containing private paths, or environment dumps.

## Public-content review

- [ ] I followed `CONTRIBUTING.md` for the PR text, comments, attachments, changes,
  and every commit in this contribution.
- [ ] No real data or private-derived summaries, statistics, distributions,
  embeddings, caches, fitted parameters, or model weights are included.
- [ ] No private media, screenshots, logs, identifiers, dates, institutional or
  personal information, local paths, credentials, or identifying metadata appear.
- [ ] Examples were invented independently; they are not renamed, sampled,
  cropped, rounded, or noised copies of real material.
- [ ] I reviewed earlier commits and deleted files, not only the final state.
- [ ] Any new public files have been explicitly reviewed for the release allowlist.

公开规则也适用于提交历史、说明、评论和附件。仅使用独立虚构的最小示例；
真实来源内容经过改名、裁剪或加噪后仍不可提交。请勿在此模板中填入私人路径、
真实编号、机构信息、日志或原始内容。
